editorial.blurb: Jeong is a beautifully refined Korean fine-dining experience where Chef Dave Park and owner Jen Tran's passion for seasonal, meticulously prepared cuisine shines through in every thoughtfully composed course.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the seasonal 8-course tasting menu with wine pairing—Chef Park's creative takes on traditional Korean dishes, like the standout scallop course with spinach and trout roe, are best experienced as an evolving culinary journey.
signatureDishes: Scallop dish with spinach and trout roe
